summary: C++ reference for the Online Services Lobbies interface: creating, finding, joining, leaving and restoring player lobbies, leader/member actions, and defining lobby schemas with attributes in DefaultEngine.ini.
gotchas: Beta feature
All lobby schemas must derive from LobbyBase; an attribute that fails schema validation makes lobby creation fail
Only the lobby leader may change lobby schema, join policy or lobby attributes
No direct Online Subsystem counterpart

summary: Explains the OnlineServices console command syntax for calling Online Services interface functions at runtime for debugging, including how to pass FAccountId, TOptional, TVariant, arrays, maps and objects as arguments.
gotchas: Beta feature
Using TSharedRef parameters in console commands crashes; use TSharedPtr
TMap syntax does not support nested objects or arrays
Custom enums need MAKE_VARIANT_ENUM_INFO to work with e: variant syntax

summary: C++ reference for the Online Services Presence interface: querying, caching and updating a user's online status, joinability, game status and rich presence string, with example code and notes on porting from Online Subsystem.
gotchas: Beta feature
SetPresence from Online Subsystem was renamed UpdatePresence; overloads became PartialUpdatePresence and BatchQueryPresence
QueryPresence bListenToChanges defaults to true

summary: Describes the Online Services Privileges interface, whose QueryUserPrivilege call checks whether a user may play online, crossplay, chat or use UGC and returns bitwise failure reasons.
gotchas: Beta feature
Privileges can change while the game is suspended; re-query when the game becomes active again

summary: C++ reference for the Online Services Sessions interface: creating, finding, joining, updating, leaving and destroying online game sessions, matchmaking, invites and presence sessions, with GetSessionByName and UpdateSessionSettings examples.
gotchas: Beta feature
Registering and unregistering players with the session after connect/disconnect is manual for now
Only the owner can set bDestroySession when leaving, which forces all members out

summary: Steps to enable the Online Services plugins (Null or EOS), add OnlineServicesInterface and CoreOnline to a module's Build.cs, set the default services in DefaultEngine.ini, and get interface pointers in C++.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires a C++ project and editor restart after enabling plugins
Online Services EOS may require registering the product with Epic Online Services

summary: Describes the Online Services Social interface for querying friends lists, sending/accepting/rejecting friend invites, and querying and blocking users.
gotchas: Beta feature
Invite and Block APIs may open a platform dialog depending on platform

summary: Explains the Online Services Stats interface: defining stats in DefaultEngine.ini, uploading with UpdateStats, querying and reading cached stats, listening to OnStatsUpdated, and running QueryStats from the console.
gotchas: Beta feature
ResetStats should not be expected to work outside testing; strip it from shipping builds with #if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
Event handles must be Unbind()-ed in shutdown code
Achievements and leaderboards need matching stats in their own config sections

summary: Full C++ tutorial that builds a Game Instance, Game Instance Subsystem and Player Controller to fetch the local online user via the Auth interface and read a Title File from the Online Services Null backend, displaying it on screen.
gotchas: Beta feature
Wizard-generated include path may fail; change to project-prefixed path
If Live Coding reports an undiagnosable build failure, close the editor and build in Visual Studio

summary: Short overview of the Online Services Title File interface for enumerating and reading title-wide files (such as config or message of the day) hosted on backend online services.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Short overview of the Online Services User File interface for enumerating, reading, writing, copying and deleting per-user files (such as cloud saves) on backend online services.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Short overview of the Online Services User Info interface for querying and getting display names and avatars of users and opening the platform profile UI.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Explains Paper 2D sprite collision settings: the Sprite Collision Domain (none, 2D, 3D extruded by thickness), collision Geometry Type options, editing collision shapes in the viewport, and the limits of the experimental Box2D integration.
gotchas: Use 2D Physics (Box2D) is experimental, unsupported and should not be used in production
Box2D only ships for Win32/Win64
Sweeps, overlaps and non-zero-extent queries are not implemented, so CharacterMovementComponent and swept moves do not work with 2D physics
Shrink Wrapped geometry is experimental and can cost performance

summary: Property reference for Modeling Mode's PolyGroup Edit tool: face operations (extrude, offset, push pull, inset, bevel, cut), edge loop/edge insertion, edge edits (weld, bridge, fill hole), planar UV projection, selection filters, topology options and hotkeys.
keys: Use Colinearity for Setting Border Groups
gotchas: Beta feature
Insert Edge Loop only works on quad-like PolyGroups with exactly four corners
Simplify by Groups destroys non-planar faces that cannot be retriangulated
Insert Edge cannot add an edge that does not split the face into separate parts

summary: Shows how to play Pose Assets in an Animation Blueprint with the Pose Blender node (driven by animation curves or a Custom Curve) and the Pose by Name node with an Alpha weight.
gotchas: Pose Blender outputs no pose unless its animation curves are driven
Additive pose assets need an Apply Additive node to display correctly

summary: Glossary of PCG Biome Core terms such as biome actor, biome asset, generator, generator/filter/transform graphs, local and global Biome Core graphs, local biome cache, injected data and runtime hierarchical generation.
gotchas: Experimental feature

summary: Overview of the PCG Biome Core plugin (data-driven biome scattering built only from native PCG nodes) and the PCG Biome Sample content plugin, with the full feature list.
gotchas: Experimental; copy the plugin into your project if shipping so future releases do not break content
5.6 changes need a global refresh by toggling enable state on Biome actors
Biome Setup actor class is deprecated; replace with Biome Texture volumes

summary: Quick start for PCG Biome Core: enabling the plugins, finding their content, placing BP_PCGBiomeCore, and creating a biome volume/spline with a definition, a BiomeGeneratorTemplate generator graph and biome assets that spawn meshes.
gotchas: Experimental feature
Depends on PCG Framework and PCG Geometry Script Interop plugins
Show Engine Content and Show Plugin Content must be enabled to see the content
Biome actors must sit inside the Biome Core volume and overlap the landscape surface

summary: In-depth reference for PCG Biome Core: local and global graph pipeline, biome cache, root asset table, generators and subtypes, filters, recursive transform graphs, priority-based difference, spawning overrides, exclusions, hierarchical generation and the GPU Biome Core Runtime graph.
keys: Treat Editor Viewport as Generation Source
gotchas: Experimental feature
Each biome needs a unique BiomeColor; lower priority values mean higher priority
Child assets without a transform graph spawn at the parent location; self-referencing children are limited only by Max Child Asset Depth
Partitioning or hierarchical generation slows full regeneration in editor but speeds partial updates

summary: How to build Unreal Engine's Linux container images from source with Docker and build.sh, for official releases or custom Git branches.
gotchas: Beta feature
Building Linux images under Windows (Docker Desktop/WSL2) is unsupported
Build scripts only support Git, not Perforce

summary: How to build Unreal Engine's Windows container images from source using Docker Desktop in Windows containers mode and build.bat.
gotchas: Beta feature
Docker Desktop must be switched from Linux containers mode to Windows containers mode
Run Setup.bat first or required files are missing

summary: Endpoint reference for the Remote Control HTTP API: calling BlueprintCallable functions, reading/writing UObject properties, searching assets, describing objects, batching requests, thumbnails and the experimental event route, plus how to build UObject paths (including PIE and CDO paths).
gotchas: Beta feature
Property access requires public properties without BlueprintGetter/Setter; EditAnywhere in editor, BlueprintVisible in PIE or -game
Use C++ function and parameter names, not Blueprint display names
remote/object/event is experimental and blocks until the event occurs

summary: Brief overview of the Remote Control C++ API classes for accessing presets, exposed properties, functions and actors, and property handles when building custom Remote Control transports or adapters.
gotchas: Complex property types (TArray, TMap, TSet, structs) must be set through child property handles

summary: HTTP endpoint reference for Remote Control Presets: listing presets, getting preset details, managing preset metadata, and reading/writing exposed properties and calling exposed functions by display name.
gotchas: Beta feature
Metadata PUT body must use the Value property or the value becomes an empty string

summary: Hub page introducing Remote Control Presets, which collect exposed properties and functions, and the Remote Control Web Interface companion web app for controlling the engine from multiple clients.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Step-by-step guide to enabling the Remote Control API plugin, starting the web server on port 30010 with WebControl console commands, and sending PUT requests to read a property and call a function on a level actor from an HTTP client.

Server only runs when explicitly started

summary: How to create a Remote Control Preset asset, open the Remote Control Panel, and expose Details panel properties (eye icon in Edit Mode) or use a Blueprint library to populate the preset for the Remote Control API.
gotchas: Beta feature
Exposing via Blueprint Library is experimental and may change

summary: Interface reference for the Remote Control Panel: menu options, exposed property controls, entity metadata (Label, ID), and DMX, MIDI and OSC protocol mappings with ranges, autobinding and the protocol log.
gotchas: Beta feature
DMX mapping allows only one channel per parameter
Default OSC server is 127.0.0.1:8001

summary: How to bind DMX, MIDI or OSC device input to properties exposed in a Remote Control Preset, and how to write a custom protocol plugin implementing IRemoteControlProtocol and FRemoteControlProtocolEntity.
gotchas: Beta feature
